title: The Rs 250 Crore AI Invoice
subtitle: When DPDP penalties, BRSR Core assurance and an AI pricing engine collide, the CFO discovers that privacy is a balance-sheet item — not a legal footnote
description: HBS-style teaching case. A labelled composite marketplace, Meridian Bazaar, has deployed an AI engine that scrapes public social profiles to refine dynamic pricing. Counsel flags a possible DPDP exposure of up to Rs 250 crore. The board wants the model live before festive season. CFO Kavya Nair must choose among shutting the scraper, buying a privacy-preserving stack, or accepting residual risk with insurance and disclosure.
sources: Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023. Significant Data Fiduciary obligations; monetary penalty ceiling of Rs 250 crore for specified contraventions.

BW CFO World, 5 September 2026. Why AI Adoption Without Governance Is A CFO's Nightmare and Indian CFOs Eye AI Governance, DPDP In 2026 Post-2025 Reset. January 2026 survey cited: 68 percent of Indian finance heads ranked DPDP compliance above GST changes.

SEBI BRSR / BRSR Core glide path. Reasonable assurance: top 150 (FY23-24), top 250 (FY24-25), top 500 (FY25-26), top 1,000 (FY26-27). Value-chain disclosure deferred; voluntary from FY25-26, assessment/assurance from FY26-27 (SEBI circular 28 March 2025).
Observer Research Foundation, January 2026. BRSR estimated about 40 percent aligned with IFRS S2; India has not adopted ISSB standards directly.
RBI Climate Finance Directions, in force November 2025.
Carbon Credit Trading Scheme (CCTS). First compliance year: about 490 obligated plants; expansion toward 740 once iron-and-steel and fertiliser targets are finalised.
KPMG India, Accounting and Auditing Update, June 2026. IFRS 9 ESG-linked financial asset classification amendments effective 1 January 2026.
ESGsource ISSB Adoption Tracker, 2 September 2026. 21-plus jurisdictions with mandatory ISSB covering about 60 percent of global GDP.
